blocking_findings.title: Unconditional workload isolation conflicts with trusted-host account authority
blocking_findings.failure_case: S1 trusted-host execution inherits same-user access while R15 unconditionally prohibits workloads from reaching account-accessible host sockets and ambient credentials. R11 and the threat model explicitly acknowledge that same-user ACLs cannot enforce that prohibition.
blocking_findings.resolution: Scope resource exclusions, enforced egress and isolated broker/workload identity guarantees to qualified restricted/managed profiles; explicitly state the account authority and absence of same-user isolation in trusted-host mode; keep R09 strong publication/failover guarantees conditional on a genuinely enforced credential boundary.

nonblocking_notes.failure_case: Future implementations could disagree about whether outcome_unknown is terminal or about allowed reconciliation/revised-change transitions.
nonblocking_notes.resolution: In S1 execution schemas and conformance vectors, enumerate terminal states and explicit authenticated reconciliation transitions while preserving the specified prohibition on replay resurrection and uncertain relaunch.

nonblocking_notes.failure_case: The deferred network broker in R02 could be confused with the required credentialed effect broker in R09.
nonblocking_notes.resolution: Rename the deferred infrastructure to message broker/stream service.
